title: Biscuit and the Watchers

scenes.title: Mouse-sized in the grass

moments.visual_point: The dreamer tiny among towering crayon grass blades.
moments.dream: The dreamer is as small as a mouse, and the grass blades are taller than them.

moments.visual_point: Biscuit's large ginger form with one white ear pressing through the grass.
moments.dream: Biscuit is as big as a bus.

moments.feeling: Safe, mostly, and a bit surreal.

moments.visual_point: Dozens of still cats gazing up from every garden.
moments.dream: Every garden has a cat sitting very still, all watching.

moments.feeling: Safe, the warmth of the tiles a comfort.

moments.looks_at: the dreamer and Biscuit on the roof
moments.feeling: Calm, safe, with a quiet sense of being watched.
moments.visual_point: The dreamer and Biscuit lying together, the watching cats below.

words: It felt like the whole thing was drawn in crayon, like when I was six. Thick waxy lines and colours going over the edges.
The grass, I think. I was as small as a mouse, all the grass blades were taller than me.
Our old cat Biscuit came through the grass. Ginger, with one white ear. She was huge to me, as big as a bus.
Yeah, she picked me up by the back of my jumper, gentle. Like how cats carry kittens.
Safe, mostly. A bit surreal. She climbed the drainpipe, up onto the roof of the house.
All the gardens in the street. And in every garden there was a cat sitting very still, dozens of them. All looking up at us.
Maybe. They just sat there, still, watching. Didn't know what they wanted.
Biscuit put me down on the roof tiles. They were warm. She lay down next to me, and that was it.
The moment on the roof, with Biscuit lying next to me. The warm tiles, all those cats in the gardens below.
Not long I don't think. It just faded after she lay down.
It slipped away, but I kept seeing the crayon colours for a bit. Not scary, just faded.
Not really. The garden was my mum's back garden, I think. Other than that, nothing else comes.
Yeah, that's it. You got it right.
Yes, I'd like that.
The waxy crayon drawing one. That's exactly how it felt.
As you imagine me, that's fine.
Oh, that looks right. Waxy and messy like it felt.
The grass being taller than me is right, and Biscuit's huge like she was.
Yeah, it's getting there. The roof view isn't up yet though.
That's fine, waiting.
The one where she's picking me up, the back of the jumper, that's right.
Yeah, gentle like that. She didn't hurt.
She's holding me by my jumper, climbing the drainpipe, yeah. That's right.
Now from the roof, all the cats in the gardens looking up. That fits.
Okay, waiting for the last one.
That's the one where she's lying next to me on the warm tiles. That's right.
